comment: The run's floating island (IslandPlan.cs). radius: tiles from the centre to the coast; coastNoise / coastScale: how much the coast wavers (share of the radius) and the size of its bays; voidMargin: tiles of sky around the island on the map; centreRatio: radius of the central zone (share of the island's); moat: tiles of void ringing the central zone; borderWidth: tiles of the barrier between two quarters (cliff or chasm, crossed by a sealed passage later); borderNoise: how much a border wavers (share of a quarter's angle); fieldScale: size of the hills and wet spots of the biome fields (lower: larger); octaves: detail of those fields.
